sentences.text: Ondogurvel is a genus of alvarezsaurid dinosaur, a group of bipedal theropods, known from the Late Cretaceous Barun Goyot Formation in southern Mongolia.
The only known species, O. alifanovi, is known from a partial skeleton including vertebrae, pelvic bones, leg bones, and hand fragments.
The species was named and described in 2022 by Alexander O. Averianov and Alexey V. Lopatin, with the specific name honoring Vladimir Alifanov, who discovered the holotype specimen in 1999.
Ondogurvel belongs to the family Alvarezsauridae and is classified within the alvarezsaurid subfamily Parvicursorinae based on hand morphology.
It lived during the Campanian stage of the Late Cretaceous, between 83.6 and 72.2 million years ago, at the end of the period in what is now Asia.
Some researchers suggest that Ondogurvel might be a junior synonym of Parvicursor, though this is debated.
